## 1. Introduction

This notebook explores the cleaned trade flows dataset to identify trends, major trading partners, and the distribution of imports/exports in the semiconductor sector.

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Set visual style
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

# Load processed data
df = pd.read_csv("../data/processed/clean_trade_flows.csv")
```

## 2. Global Trade Volume Over Time

```{python}
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
yearly_trend = df.groupby(['Year', 'Flow_Type'])['Trade_Value_USD'].sum().unstack()
yearly_trend.plot(kind='line', marker='o', ax=plt.gca())
plt.title('Global Semiconductor Trade Volume (2019-2023)')
plt.ylabel('Trade Value (USD)')
plt.xlabel('Year')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## 3. Top Importers and Exporters

We identify the dominant players in the semiconductor supply chain.

```{python}
# Filter for 2023
df_2023 = df[df['Year'] == 2023]

# Top Importers
top_importers = df_2023[df_2023['Flow_Type'] == 'Import'].groupby('Reporter_Country')['Trade_Value_USD'].sum().nlargest(5)

# Top Exporters
top_exporters = df_2023[df_2023['Flow_Type'] == 'Export'].groupby('Reporter_Country')['Trade_Value_USD'].sum().nlargest(5)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 6))
sns.barplot(x=top_importers.values, y=top_importers.index, ax=axes[0], palette="Blues_d")
axes[0].set_title('Top 5 Semiconductor Importers (2023)')
axes[0].set_xlabel('Total Import Value (USD)')

sns.barplot(x=top_exporters.values, y=top_exporters.index, ax=axes[1], palette="Greens_d")
axes[1].set_title('Top 5 Semiconductor Exporters (2023)')
axes[1].set_xlabel('Total Export Value (USD)')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
